reviewer_type: assistant-assisted retrospective textual review with gold-hidden extraction packets and root adjudication; not independent human certification

policy.scope: All 87 V8 NO_PARSE records; response interpretation only, no model inference or scorer changes.
criteria: CLEAR: one unambiguous final committed answer. Mathematical notation may be read when equivalence is transparent.
A later answer can replace an earlier answer only when the response explicitly corrects/retracts the earlier conclusion; unresolved differing final commitments are AMBIGUOUS.
Tentative answers (perhaps/maybe/closest despite invalid assumptions), persistent contradictions, label/text disagreement, and incomplete last commitments are AMBIGUOUS.
A formula or number matching multiple options without a committed label is AMBIGUOUS.
No committed final answer is NO_FINAL. Merely mentioning an option does not establish a final answer.
A length-stopped response may be CLEAR only if a complete final answer exists and later text does not retract, contradict, or make it tentative.
Do not solve the original question to manufacture an answer. Extract only what the saved response commits to.
Compare gold only after blind extraction; ambiguous/no-final receive no rescued point.
limitations: Compact views show response head/tail and unique answer-related paragraphs; full gold-blind raw files remain available for targeted inspection.
This is an assistant-assisted retrospective review, not a new deterministic parser or human-certified score.
NO_PARSE subset only: PARSED records are not manually re-audited.
